source: Sánchez-Marqués and Sánchez, DATASET_MULTIMODAL_V8, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.22029053, CC BY 4.0, as extracted to example-2024-brazil-dengue/data/dengue-rj-2010-2025.csv. tempmed is InfoDengue's weekly mean air temperature; precip_total_semana is CHIRPS at one grid cell.

declaredParameters.semantics: Poisson regression of casos on tempmed, adjusted for precip_total_semana, with one stratum per combination of municipio, anio and mes absorbed by the conditional Poisson likelihood; a stratum with no events is dropped. A row missing a model column is left out. Overdispersed: model-based standard errors multiplied by the square root of the Pearson chi-square over the residual degrees of freedom, those being rows used minus columns minus strata used.
declaredParameters.equivalentTo: statsmodels: sm.GLM(casos, [tempmed, precip_total_semana, indicators of municipio x anio x mes], family=Poisson()).fit(scale='X2'), over rows with every column present and strata with at least one case.

note: Recompute from input.rows: drop rows missing any model column, drop strata with no cases, fit with one indicator per stratum, scale by the Pearson statistic.

integrity.note: SHA-256 of this fixture with the integrity field removed, serialised with object keys sorted, no whitespace and UTF-8. Not the file's bytes: the lab reads fixtures through a transport that re-serialises JSON.
